title: Derived module inverse image is left adjoint to a supplied derived direct image
statement: Let $f:(X,R_X)\to(Y,R_Y)$ be a morphism of ringed topoi presented by small sites [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism], with their module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Choose unbounded derived categories $D(R_Y)$ and $D(R_X)$ in independent localization universes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $q_T$ for localization of complexes and $Q_T$ for localization of the homotopy category. Let $Rf:D(R_X)\to D(R_Y)$ have a natural comparison $\rho:q_Y\circ f_*^{\mathrm{complex}}\to Rf\circ q_X$ universal as a right derived functor at quasi-isomorphisms. Assume $\rho_I$ is invertible for every K-injective complex $I$ [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Then there exist $L:D(R_Y)\to D(R_X)$ with $L\dashv Rf$ and an additive module functor $G:\operatorname{Mod}(R_Y)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R_X)$ with $G\dashv f_*$. There is a comparison $\epsilon:L\circ Q_Y\to Q_X\circ G^{K}$ universal as a left derived functor on homotopy categories, where $G^K$ is induced termwise by $G$. This comparison is invertible on every K-flat complex with flat terms [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. No ideal or completion hypotheses are imposed.

proof.text: The supplied ringed-topos K-flat pullback theorem constructs an additive module left adjoint G to f.modules which preserves quasi-isomorphisms between flat-term K-flat complexes.

Every complex has a flat-term K-flat resolution. Their homotopy images form a resolving class; the resolving-class theorem constructs L and its homotopy left-derived comparison. Its comparison is invertible on the resolving class, which is retained in the conclusion. Fullness of the homotopy quotient transfers this universal property to complexes.

The denominator pro-diagrams are essentially constant, so postcomposition by Rf preserves this left-derived comparison. K-injective derivability and the supplied computation property show that postcomposition of Rf by L is still right derived. Use Mathlib Adjunction.derived on the original complex adjunction.

theorem RingedToposMorphism.exists_derivedLeftAdjoint
    {C X : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory X]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology X}
    [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})]
    [K.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})]
    (RY : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (RX : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wY} (ringedSiteModules.{u, u, u, u}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RY))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (ringedSiteModules.{u, u, u, u}
      ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RX))]
    (f : RingedToposMorphism
      ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RX)
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RY))
    (Rf : ringedSiteDerived.{u, wX} RX ⥤ ringedSiteDerived.{u, wY} RY)
    (ρ : f.modules.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q.{wY} (C := ringedSiteModules.{u, u, u, u}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RY)) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.{wX} (C := ringedSiteModules.{u, u, u, u}
        ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RX)) ⋙ Rf)
    (hRf : Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor ρ
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ringedSiteModules.{u, u, u, u}
        ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RX)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hCompute : ∀ I : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u, u, u, u}
      ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RX)) ℤ,
      I.IsKInjective → IsIso (ρ.app I)) :
    ∃ L : ringedSiteDerived.{u, wY} RY ⥤ ringedSiteDerived.{u, wX} RX,
      Nonempty (L ⊣ Rf) ∧
      ∃ G : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RY) ⥤
          ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RX),
        Nonempty (G ⊣ f.modules) ∧ ∃ hG : G.Additive,
        letI := hG
        ∃ ε : DerivedCategory.Qh.{wY} ⋙ L ⟶
            G.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh.{wX},
          L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RY))
            (.up ℤ)) ∧
          ∀ P : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{u}
              ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj RY)) ℤ,
            P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat →
            (∀ n : ℤ, (P.X n).IsFlat) →
            IsIso (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))
